description: Task A: claim extractor + fixtures. Pure TypeScript in src/core/adf and src/core/claims. Parallel with FEAT-003, FEAT-005, FEAT-006, FEAT-007 after FEAT-001. Implements PLAN.md section 6.
steps: src/core/adf/walk.ts: walk an ADF doc (including bodiedExtension content) into TextBlock[] { blockIndex, nodeType, text, marks: {start,end,type}[] } for paragraph, heading, listItem paragraphs, tableCell paragraphs, codeBlock, blockquote, panel; hardBreak becomes newline.

src/core/claims/http.ts: METHOD /path, bare /vN/ paths in code spans, curl -X/--request + URL; normalize params ({id}, :id, <id>, <int:id>) to :param, strip trailing slash, query and fragment; keep host separately.
src/core/claims/env.ts: UPPER_SNAKE names with env cues (code span, export, $, ${, process.env., os.environ, KEY=value in code blocks) and a stop-list.

src/core/claims/cli.ts: tokenizer for code spans and code-block lines; strip '$ ' prompts; program + subcommands + flags (--x, --x=v -> --x, -s); special handling for npm run / yarn / pnpm / make; skip a list of well-known external tools except curl (handed to http.ts).
src/core/claims/config.ts, files.ts, packages.ts per PLAN.md section 6 table.

src/core/claims/index.ts: extractClaims(adf) and extractClaimsFromText(text) returning Claim[] with stable ids (c_<hash8>), confidence high for code marks/blocks and medium for prose, caps of 200 per document and 20 per block, claimsTruncated flag.
test/core/claims/*.test.ts: table-driven positive and negative cases per type, including all six demo claims from PLAN.md 10.2 and the fixed-page variant.

test/core/claims/properties.test.ts (fast-check): never throws on arbitrary strings and random ADF trees; raw equals substring at offsets; normalization idempotent; generated endpoints/env vars/flags inside random prose are found; file path normalizer never outputs '..'.
acceptance_criteria: npm test passes including all claim tests and properties (1,000 runs each)
Demo runbook ADF from demo/confluence (or an inline copy until FEAT-007 lands) yields exactly the six expected claims with correct types
src/core/claims and src/core/adf have at least 90% line coverage
